Welcome to Xperia KitKat Icons!


This icon pack brings the classic design of Sony Xperia Z-series and Android 4.4 KitKat to modern Android launchers like Nova, Lawnchair, and Niagara.


💡 Tip: Long-press any app icon on your launcher home screen, tap Edit, and tap the icon to browse all alternative styles and retro variants!
